The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
The run failed with an AssertionError in test_word_summary_content at /tests/test_outputs.py:204. While 5 tests passed, the verifier reported 'assert 0 >= 2' regarding the mention of top facility-session combinations in the OUTPUT_DOCX file. The planner should ensure the Word document logic correctly identifies and writes the top 4 sessions (e.g., 'FAC-SESS' format) based on variance totals to satisfy the summary content requirements.
